title: How to Watch
text: NWSL+ streams live NWSL games, match recaps, and highlights. It’s free online, and on the NWSL+ app on Apple TV, Fire TV, and Roku.

title: How to Watch
text: NWSL+ streams live NWSL games, match recaps, and highlights. It’s free online, and on the NWSL+ app on Apple TV, Fire TV, and Roku.

title: How to Watch
text:
CBS
CBS games can be watched on your local CBS affiliate (over-the-air or via cable/satellite). Streaming on Paramount+ is only available on the Paramount+ with SHOWTIME (Premium) plan. The cheaper Paramount+ Essentials plan does not include live local CBS streams.No matches are streaming-only on Paramount+. This is a change from prior seasons.

title: How to Watch
text:
CBS Sports Network (CBSSN)
You typically need cable or streaming subscription to watch CBSSN. You can search for TV Providers by zipcode at the CBS Sports Network website.

title: How to Watch
text:
Victory+
Victory+ is the newest streaming partner of the NWSL. It’s a free for live streaming and on-demand sports entertainment across major platforms.
After you’ve created a Victory+ account, you can download the Victory+ app on your smart TV and pair your account.
National Women’s Soccer League’s Victory+ FAQ site.

title: How to Watch
text:
Arsenal and Chelsea
Arsenal and Chelsea appear here for their WSL, UEFA Women’s Champions League, and English domestic cup fixtures. Most of these kick off in the late morning ET — use the GMT button on the schedule pages to see the local UK kickoff time.
WSL and Champions League matches are listed on Paramount+, with some also on CBS Sports Network, ESPN+, or ESPN Deportes. The Stream column on each match row links to whichever service ESPN lists for that fixture.
FA Cup and League Cup ties often show TBD — those rounds are frequently scheduled before a US broadcaster is announced, and the listing fills in once ESPN publishes one.
